scope: All files under reference except reference/inventory.json and Python bytecode caches; nested inventories are included.

camera_back_firmware.image_count_definition: Unique original main/recovery UPD images plus Windows CE BIN ROM containers; UBF board payloads and configuration are counted separately.
camera_back_firmware.note: Classic shared 4.701 contains an Aptus 22 model descriptor and is the primary Aptus 22-related evidence, not a model-exclusive flashing package. Aptus II has no Bluetooth hardware; shared PDA code in 5.041 does not establish a radio. Original names/bytes and all 310 aliases are retained; actual wireless effects remain device/firmware-specific.

source_locks.scope: WiView original client media and guides
Firmware original payloads and source aliases

entries.provenance: Static experimental candidate metadata. Confirmed vendor constructions, firmware parser/handler evidence and unconfirmed research names are distinguished; user-created hypothesis headers are not extracted vendor syntax.
